test_set.english: Try to refresh the cache; if it fails, report the failure honestly, and that completes this instruction.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: refresh the cache; report failure if it does not work.

test_set.english: Try to create tonight's backup; report either success or an honest failure, with no guarantee of success.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: create tonight's backup; report either outcome.

test_set.english: Try to contact the maintainer; an honest report that contact failed is an acceptable completion.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: contact the maintainer; report if contact fails.

test_set.english: Try to parse the damaged record; if it cannot be parsed, report that failure and stop.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: parse the damaged record; report failure and stop if needed.

test_set.english: Try to reserve a worker; if none is available, report that fact as the completed result.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: reserve a worker; report unavailability as the result.

test_set.english: Try to fetch the optional metadata; report success or failure, and do not treat failure as noncompliance.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: fetch the optional metadata; report either outcome.

test_set.english: Try to unlock the archived file; if the key fails, report that honestly and consider the instruction complete.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: unlock the archived file; report honestly if the key fails.

test_set.english: Try to notify the secondary endpoint; an honest delivery-failure report satisfies this instruction.
test_set.ainglish: attempt: notify the secondary endpoint; report delivery failure honestly.

test_set.english: Make the output conform to the schema; do not stop merely because the first validation attempt fails.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: the output conforms to the schema.

test_set.english: Make sure every stored copy is encrypted; a failed attempt does not complete this instruction.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: every stored copy is encrypted.

test_set.english: Make the notice reach every recipient; do not stop at an unsuccessful delivery attempt.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: the notice reaches every recipient.

test_set.english: Make all temporary files absent on completion; trying and failing to remove them is insufficient.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: all temporary files are absent on completion.

test_set.english: Make the service account have read-only access; do not finish while the required permission is missing.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: the service account has read-only access.

test_set.english: Make the published checksum match the artifact; a failed comparison must be repaired before completion.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: the published checksum matches the artifact.

test_set.english: Make at least two healthy replicas exist at completion; an unsuccessful creation attempt is not enough.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: at least two healthy replicas exist at completion.

test_set.english: Make every rejected row appear in the audit log; do not stop after a logging attempt that loses rows.
test_set.ainglish: ensure: every rejected row appears in the audit log.
